paragraphs.source_en: What, at this moment, was Shimazu Yoshihiro really contemplating?

units.source_en: What, at this moment, was Shimazu Yoshihiro really contemplating?
units.source_zh: 此时的岛津义弘，究竟在思量什么？

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时的岛津义弘，究竟在思量什么？

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari repeatedly sent messengers to press him, but Yoshihiro would not even receive them; even when his nephew Toyohisa or one of his senior retainers came, he said not a word. Perhaps he had long since formed another plan in his heart: so long as the Kikkawa and Mōri forces on Mount Nangū did not move, he too would hold his troops in place. Yet his position was very different from that of the Kikkawa and Mōri.

units.source_en: Mitsunari repeatedly sent messengers to press him, but Yoshihiro would not even receive them; even when his nephew Toyohisa or one of his senior retainers came, he said not a word.
units.source_zh: 三成接连派人催促，但义弘却连面都不见，即使侄子丰久或重臣来了，他也不发一言。

units.source_en: Perhaps he had long since formed another plan in his heart: so long as the Kikkawa and Mōri forces on Mount Nangū did not move, he too would hold his troops in place.

ja.t: かさないつもりだったのかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 或许他心中早就另有打算，只要南宫山上的吉川和毛利不动，他便按兵不发。

units.source_en: Yet his position was very different from that of the Kikkawa and Mōri.
units.source_zh: 但他与吉川、毛利却大有不同。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成接连派人催促，但义弘却连面都不见，即使侄子丰久或重臣来了，他也不发一言。或许他心中早就另有打算，只要南宫山上的吉川和毛利不动，他便按兵不发。但他与吉川、毛利却大有不同。

paragraphs.source_en: Even if he folded his arms and ceased fighting, the Shimazu clan would not thereby be secure, nor would its men thereby be saved. His men were fighting desperately, drenched in blood. And yet he sat here in silence, looking on indifferently as his loyal and valiant retainers fell one after another on the battlefield.

units.source_en: Even if he folded his arms and ceased fighting, the Shimazu clan would not thereby be secure, nor would its men thereby be saved.
units.source_zh: 即使他束手息兵，岛津氏也不会因此安泰，士众也不会因此获救。

units.source_en: His men were fighting desperately, drenched in blood.
units.source_zh: 他的属下正在浴血奋战。

units.source_en: And yet he sat here in silence, looking on indifferently as his loyal and valiant retainers fell one after another on the battlefield.
units.source_zh: 而他静坐于此，漠视忠烈的部下一个个战死沙场。

paragraphs.source_zh: 即使他束手息兵，岛津氏也不会因此安泰，士众也不会因此获救。他的属下正在浴血奋战。而他静坐于此，漠视忠烈的部下一个个战死沙场。

paragraphs.source_en: By noon, the warriors on both sides had reached the limits of their endurance, and one after another began collapsing onto the muddy ground…

units.source_en: By noon, the warriors on both sides had reached the limits of their endurance, and one after another began collapsing onto the muddy ground…
units.source_zh: 午时，双方将士的体力已达极限，泥泞的地上，陆续有人倒下……

paragraphs.source_zh: 午时，双方将士的体力已达极限，泥泞的地上，陆续有人倒下……
